TEXT.English: Decius has fled his homeland after being charged with witchcraft and conjuring demons. He seeks to preserve his values and find a new beginning among the Malakim, across the seas in the desert of Myrh. This ancient tribal people is coalescing around an unlikely new spiritual leader-the elf Varn Gosam, a refugee from an isolated elven community.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Malakim have taken in Decius and his entourage; hospitality in the desert is an iron law. He has yet to see meet his host, however.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]While watching the young soldiers drill in the evening Decius is approached by a raven-haired woman flanked by a sand lion cub. Flowing robes keep the sun off her skin but do nothing to hide her figure as the wind blows them taut against her. "Welcome, stranger. You have the look of one who well knows the art these boys struggle to master."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"I was a soldier of some renown, milady, and a commander for a season. I felled my people's enemies, until I was deemed one."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Strong and wise, and bereft of your heritage, like our Varn. We could make use of your skills, in exchange for a place of refuge."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"A gracious offer, milady. Have you the authority to make it?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"It is not authority I wield here, just influence, but I suspect it will be enough. More so if you could perform one task for us now. Varn Gosam has been gone for some time on pilgrimage, too long I fear. Lead a party to find him, east at the Mirror of Heaven, and you will have proven your worth and earned your place."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Decius rises with a nod. "I shall do so then. Who shall I say has commissioned this search?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The lady smiles. "My name is Talia."

德西乌斯在风吹日晒下穿过了变化无常的沙丘，渐渐接近了马拉基姆的圣地。穿过平坦的玻璃地区非常危险，范恩·哥萨姆就在那中央像水晶一样透明的湖旁边。在温暖的光芒的包围下，范恩向率领着士兵的这位表情严肃的指挥官致意。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]「你就是德西乌斯吧。我为了追寻光之神罗格斯的指示来到了这里。他给与我天命，引导我离开阴影之谷一路前行。我很感激马拉基姆，他们接受了你一如曾经接受了我一样。他们的博爱穿过了沙丘，满撒在这大地上。跟随他们，毫无疑问你也会找到你的使命。」[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]德西乌斯的视线游移到闪烁着光芒的水面上。「班诺尔的神官们给了我一个明确的使命。与邪恶战斗到底，根绝异教徒。我忠实地执行他们的命令，直到我被背叛为止。目前我对这种不受约束的日子感到很满足。」[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]范恩笑了一下。「今天对你来说是重生的一天，德西乌斯。黑夜即将来临，已经没有可供瞌睡的时间。为了那些热爱温柔和自由的人们，罗格斯向我展示了在那遥远的地方邪恶和愚蠢的姿态。我们必须在灾难降临之前行动起来，和所有的善良民族团结在一起对抗那个巨大的邪恶。为了这个神圣的目的，你能陪我一起走下去吗？首先是这个沙漠里的同胞部族，我们要抛弃前嫌团结在一起，然后是埃洛希姆守护者，库里奥塔特人，卡扎德王国的矮人，勒约沙尔法的精灵──甚至是班诺尔联邦。」[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]「我不会背叛我所信的。如果真如您说得那样的话，我会为您和您的使命献上我的力量，范恩。即使需要我同那些想要杀死我的人合作。」[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]「作为回报，你将不会孤独。这是天空的神示。」范恩．哥萨姆把香油、水袋、简易帐篷、腌肉装进了骆驼背着的袋子里。和德西乌斯一起回到游牧民那里后，他的语调变作了另外一个人。「罗格斯还传达给我一件事情，德西乌斯。住在我们西方的人民拥有一个邪恶的秘密。他们对我们的善良神明有着远古的怨恨。我们的教义传播越广，他们的怨恨越积越深。有如此的执念，他们一定会用剑和魔法和我们为敌。」[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]「对抗这种敌人我有着丰富的经验，范恩。让传教士们做好准备。保护他们是我的士兵们的使命。」

德西乌斯在马拉基姆找到了自己新的位置，现在协助范恩．哥萨姆完成他的事业。在至高议会之下把善良国家联合在一起，为了和预言的太古敌人作战而做准备。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]然而他在麦尔沙漠里的成功正面临考验。埃洛希姆的使者刚刚到达，请求他们的盟友马拉基姆给予帮助。塞安隐修会，一个在埃洛希姆西边的神秘部族，举行了一个黑暗的仪式，把阿加雷斯的大天使魔王海勃雷姆，召唤到了厄瑞波斯大陆上。海勃雷姆率领着他的地狱军队出现在坦帕斯摩尔的山脉中，在遥远的西方无数的恶魔加入了他的侵略军。与此同时，斯瓦塔尔法利用这个机会向宿敌宣战，重开数年前因一位女王的逝去而终止的精灵战争。白袍艾斯妮警告说她会以生命来守护她的人民，因此范恩．哥萨姆要求德西乌斯率领马拉基姆的西方面军保护至高议会的的盟友，给坦帕斯摩尔带来和平。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]尽管曾经被班诺尔背叛过一次，他们教给德西乌斯的技巧将会受到考验。
巨角炎魔领主
TEXT.German: Fürst der Balor

TEXT.English: 冰河时代的人们在这里献祭，试图去平息他们认为的“神”的愤怒。因为在这样一个冰封的世界中，一片有着火焰燃烧的土地对这些原始的人类来说就足以算作天堂了。但是，这些“神”们要求的牺牲有时候比寒冷的冬季造成的更多。
TEXT.German: Während des Zeitalters des Eises brachten die Menschen hier Opfer dar, um jene zu besänftigen, die sie für die jenseitigen Götter hielten. In einer Welt des permanenten Winters erschienen die brennenden Lande des Jenseits den primitiven Menschen dieses Zeitalters wie eine verdrehte Version des Himmels. Aber diese "Götter" forderten Opfergaben von ihren Gläubigen, die oft kostspieliger als die Kälte waren.

TEXT.English: This altar is for the Lord of the Balors. The vast minions of hell sacrifice here in the hope of gaining some favor with Hyborem. Many generals have made it this far, but you are the first that wasn't carried here by demonic legions and sacrificed on the black and red stone.
TEXT.German: Dieser Altar ist dem Meister der Balor geweiht. Die vielen Lakaien der Hölle bringen hier ihre Opfer in der Hoffnung dar, eine kleine Gunst von Hyborem zu erhalten. Viele Generäle haben es bis hier geschafft, aber Ihr seid der erste, der nicht von den dämonischen Legionen hierher getragen und auf dem schwarz-roten Stein geopfert wurde.

TEXT.English: 巴尔塞拉弗人远远的看着迪斯城，即使他们有着疯狂的想象力，但这座城市仍然超越了他们的想象界限。城前的道路被黑色的纪念碑铺满，见证着魔王海勃雷姆的累累功勋。敢于和魔王作对的人的尸体要么铸就了这些纪念碑，要么被遗弃在路边的水沟中。硫磺和恶臭和尸体的焦糊味混杂在一起，和这种味道相比，朱布里城贫民区里最肮脏的地方也像是天堂。迪斯城高大的城墙耸立着，没人敢想，在领主的恐惧下，到底有多少人在城里做着苦工，也没有人敢想到底有多少人被武装起来保卫这座城市。[NEWLINE]“这个味道闻起来很有趣，”琪琳说到，“但是如果我们给这座城市换件新衣裳应该会更好，我觉得粉红色就很不错。粉红色能让一切东西看起来更美好。”
TEXT.German: Die Balseraph starrten auf die ferne Stadt Dis, die Furcht einflößender war, als sie es sich selbst mit ihrer lebhaften Vorstellungskraft hätten ausmalen können. Der Pass ist gespickt mit dunklen Monumenten für Hyborems zahllosen Taten. Die Leichen seiner Feinde sind in diese Monumente eingelassen oder über die Einöde verstreut, als Warnung für jene, die versuchen sollten, ihn zu besiegen. Der Gestank von Schwefel und verrotendem Fleisch vermischen sich und lassen den dreckigsten Slum von Jubilee wie ein Paradies erscheinen. Und die grauenvolle Metropole Dis selbst thront über allem. Keiner der Balseraph wagt sich auch nur vorzustellen, wieviele verdammte Seelen in dieser elenden Stadt gequält werden, oder wieviele davon bewaffnet und lieber bereit sind, sie zu verteidigen, als die Verärgerung ihrer Meister zu riskieren.[PARAGRAPH:1]"Es riecht komisch", sagt Keelyn, "aber es könnte mit einem neuen Anstrich ganz hübsch sein. Ich denke an Rosa. Alles sieht in Rosa schöner aus."

TEXT.English: The Mercurian men cheered. These were fierce, passionate men who viewed their lives as a temporary stage before their transform into the magnificent angels of Basium's army. They threw themselves fully into battle and marched unquestioning into the Fane of Lessers. Death in righteous battle was their hope. There was no such thing as an old Mercurian soldier.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The angels were more somber. The Seraphim with their blazing swords kept careful watch for more dangers, the Ophanim floated above the broken fields for the first time riding unhindered within the Fane and the Valkyries tended to the dead.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Basium stood before the Throne of Hell, a vast gaping hole in Erebus. The ground around it bled a thick, dark ichor. It was a physical wound in this world, fully contaminated and defiled. Through it hell could be seen, a vast mountain sloping ever down to dark swamps. Somewhere beyond that swamp Basium knew the foul city of Mammon sat. It was the first step in turning the souls of men into demons.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Basium raised his club, within it demons howled in pain and torment, for it wouldn't let any demon it killed return to their immortal realms. Two Seraphim settled beside the portal, swords drawn.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Factum est." the Seraphim intoned.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Not yet" Basium replied, "our battle is not done. If we mean to truly defeat the Infernal we must tear down the city of Mammon, march across the fields of Camulos and destroy the temples of Aeron. Then we will rouse Agares himself, send an army into the dust sea and remove him from his dominion."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]With that Basium marched through the gate and his army marched unquestioningly after him. After they had all passed through they destroyed the gate behind them. An entire army, a nation, walked willingly into hell and disappeared from Erebus.
TEXT.German: Bald!

TEXT.English: 他们比之前的任何一支人类部队都走得要深入。他们有同伴在背后支持，虽然不论是勇敢的马拉基姆游牧民，多变但依然奇迹般可以信赖的巴尔塞拉弗族，还是最忠实于圣战的天界军团，对他们的表现只给与了有限的尊重，但班诺尔联邦的战士们，永远战斗在最前线，这是他们的信条。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]这支队伍里，除了指挥官外，还没有战士经历过地狱之火的考验。那些从地狱里逃出的男人和女人的那一代是濒临死亡的一代，但他们的经历，却被后来出生在厄瑞波斯大陆的后代们广为传颂和学习着。这样狂野的信念和老一辈的传奇支持着这些新兵们继续坚定不移的投入战斗之中。班诺尔联邦的骑士、平民十字军、祭祀，他们勇敢的向着魔殿进军，无情的消灭着阻拦的敌人，直至推翻魔王海勃雷姆的统治。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]凯布瑞尔在迪斯城——魔王海勃雷姆的巢穴，一座巨大的城市——的废墟中搜索着，城市的地牢错综复杂。街道上满是恶毒的陷阱，邪恶残忍的现象到处都是：人们被钉死在十字架上、倒吊于高塔之下、或是头部以下皆被埋入土中。清理这个城市并拯救这些可怜的灵魂需要很长的时间，但不管怎么说，目前这座城市的毁灭还是一件大喜事。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]可惜的是，她并没有找到她最初来时想找的东西。凯布瑞尔轻叹一声，转向魔殿所在的角落，同时也是恶灵们最后的栖身之所。魔殿已经被投石车的轰炸破坏得破破烂烂，但仍然可以看到一个传送门矗立其中。跟在凯布瑞尔身边的术士接近了它，这时几只地狱犬突然冲了出来，凯布瑞尔立刻冲上去挡在术士前面。她的重盾挡住了一只地狱犬的冲击，这时，地狱犬后方飞来一支长矛，将地狱犬钉死在地面，其他的地狱犬纷纷绕道而逃，没有再发起攻击。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]凯布瑞尔稍稍降下了一点她的盾牌，她不禁睁大了眼睛，神子卢乌，他们所寻找了很久的传奇人物，那个处在队伍最后，替所有人争取到了逃跑时间的英雄，就站在她的眼前。卢乌的头发和胡子都已花白，但凯布瑞尔依然可以确认他的身份。“卢乌……我们是来找你的。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]卢乌拍了拍面前年老的女士，“是的，小不点，非常感谢。在地狱中活下来可真不是件容易的事，在这里，这个地狱军团的老巢战斗几乎让我丧失了希望。知道我听到此处开始遭受攻击，我知道这一定是我们的人来终结这一切了，他们会让恶魔们付出代价。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“我一直没机会谢谢你。我们现在需要你的回来，老朋友，我们已经失去了萨巴曦尔，现在有许多人甚至开始追求权力胜过正义。”"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]卢乌静静的握着她的手，两个人都没有说话。“下一场战争很快就要开始，我将会出现在那里。战争不会结束——这也是我们被选中的原因。不过，现在我们可以稍微休息一下了，我相信我们已经获得了这个资格。”在他们身后，术士切断了魔殿与地狱的联系，传送门在爆炸中消失了。
TEXT.German: Bald!

TEXT.English: 最开始，我以为我来到了[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]阿玛萨恩[COLOR_REVERT]的天堂。我犯下过数不清的欺骗、盗窃和其他各类犯罪，我甚至将普宾塔克的女儿送到了地狱，但我仍然把这里看做了天堂！或许这是神对我干掉那个乳臭未干的小女孩的奖励吧。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]我目睹了花园，漂亮的雕像，有着特别趣味的云彩，以及穿着红与白的天使们——虽然那些天使们长着长角和巨大的牙齿。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]花园里生长着地狱蔷薇和剃刀草，以及更多具有地狱意味的植物。雕像里不是俊男美女，而是魅魔和恶魔。我见到的天空，比起粉色来说更接近深红，一朵朵云彩从火山口中冒出来。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]这里和我想象的受苦的地狱不同，但确实就是地狱。这时一个穿着奇装异服的恶魔向我走来，“琪琳公主希望你去她那跳舞”。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“公主...琪琳公主？”我喃喃说道，感觉难以置信。我被拽到了一个巨大的大厅中。大厅里摆放着一个巨型的王座，在那个王座之上又放着一个较小的王座，和下面那个比起来，这个王座就像是从玩具室里拿出来的，而琪琳就坐在上面！我不敢相信自己的眼睛。琪琳公主居然坐在魔王海勃雷姆的座位上。我将她送到了地狱，但她却夺取了地狱的王位。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“你就是那个送给我船的大臣吧？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“是的，”我回答说，尽量淡化我们之间的仇恨，“还记得我们在一起的快乐日子吗...”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“你讨厌我，你总是对我非常吝啬，”她说着，“你唯一做的可以称赞的事就是给我那艘船”她倾下身子，“但那是因为你想害死我。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]我无话可说，只能等待她接下来的话。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“跳舞。”她命令我。我跳着，但不知道要跳到何时。她打着拍子，显得非常高兴，但仍然没有要我停下的意思。我最终体力不支，倒在了地上。“不要停下，继续跳！”她命令说，但我实在动不了了。“守卫！”她叫到，“他不愿意跳舞了，那么把他送到淘气深渊去！”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]在我被巨角炎魔拖走的时候，听着前方传来的尖叫声，看着巨角炎魔脸上的诡异笑容，我知道所谓的“淘气深渊”，一定比跳舞至死更加可怕。

这是太阳首次在魔殿上空升起，魔殿上空沉闷的烟雾开始散去。空气中依然弥漫着怅然的感觉，但更像是出现在梦中而非现实。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]伴随着光而来的还有天使；不是巴希姆手下的那种野蛮的天使，而是慈祥亲切的天使，他们治愈着伤者和灵魂们。那些陷得最深的灵魂都已在地狱王座沦陷时逃往了地狱。留下的都是被恶魔强行带来或是被骗到这里的。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]我走在这些灵魂之间，祝福那些祈求原谅的灵魂，安慰那些孤独痛苦的灵魂。我的同伴也是如此，尽管他们都已疲惫不堪，但他们仍不愿停下片刻。现在的情况就像我们从暴君手下解放了一个王国——实际上这些灵魂所受到的折磨远胜那些暴政下的子民。对于很多灵魂来说，这是他们几个世纪以来第一次得到关爱。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]走着走着我看到前方有一棵大树，大树的枝干被绳索捆缚着，就像这片大地上的一切事物一样，被深深的折磨着。一位术士净化了这里，这棵大树有焦黑变为苍绿，又随之消失。塔利亚的灵魂从中出现，向我走来。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]我们在沉默中看着对方。我已是精疲力尽、遍布伤疤；她则已成为鬼魂，漂浮在地面上，身上穿着长袍似的东西。现在的她看起来好像我们结婚时她的一个灰色影子，坚强而美丽。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“我永远爱你。”我说。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]她微微一笑，但眼里藏着悲伤。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]术士的魔法这时已扩散开来，大地开始恢复如新。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“如今我已是这个世界，”她说“所有树木，所有河流，所有高山。拯救了这些土地，你就拯救了我。你以后在向日葵地里睡觉时会梦见我的，我也永远的爱你并会梦见你。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]说完她便消逝于空中。我跪在地上，悲痛不已。但我身边，大地继续变化着，细小的薰衣草开始生长，空气中充满了芳香，我知道，她就在我身边。
城墙的道路宽阔而拥挤，充斥着各国的旗帜，每一面旗帜都代表着一支向魔殿进军却没有回来的部队。远处的欢呼声依然在道路上回响，那是各国反抗地狱军团的宣言。

巴尔塞拉弗族士兵看着通道上的各式旗帜。[NEWLINE]“看看他们，就像是一场狂欢节！”琪琳笑着说。[NEWLINE]他的部下却愈发紧张了，这些旗帜中有许多甚至来自于那些早已只存在于传说中的国家。[NEWLINE]但琪琳只是饶有兴致的看着他们：“有些旗帜真好看，我要得到它们！我们要做的就是把那些好看的旗帜拿来！这个难度有多大？”[NEWLINE]一个身着菘蓝短裙的魔童出现在她身边。“这些旗帜是那些被打败的国家留下的。他们曾经是很强大的国家，但现在已经消逝于时光之中了。”魔童笑着说，一边打了个响指，召唤出一个箱子。[NEWLINE]琪琳观察了一下那些旗帜，然后指着一面画着黄铜灯笼的黑色旗帜，和一面有诡异兔齿的绿鱼旗帜。“我觉得它们比较不错”。
吾之激愤永世不灭。待吾苏生之日，必重返此征途。
TEXT.German: Ich werde ewig wüten. Egal in welcher Form ich wiedergeboren werde, ich werde erneut gegen die Infernalen ins Feld ziehen.

TEXT.English: 是荣耀引领着我向地狱进发，我唯一遗憾的只是我们牺牲了这么多生命。
TEXT.German: Es war der Stolz, der mich nun wieder in die Hölle geführt hat. Ich bedauere nur all die Leben, die es uns gekostet hat.

TEXT.English: 这海此刻有了更红的颜色——[NEWLINE] 而这时，那座城将下沉，下沉， [NEWLINE] 从此再听不见人世的呻吟。[NEWLINE] 地狱，从一千个王位上升起，[NEWLINE] 将对它表示深深的敬意。[NEWLINE] [NEWLINE]
我反身潜入黑暗，这次失败并未终结我的传说。
TEXT.German: Zurück in die Finsternis gehe ich. Dieses einfach Schicksal wird nicht das Ende meiner Legende sein.

TEXT.English: 这里一点都不好玩……这些红色的玩具把我的玩具都弄坏了。我要到其他地方去当公主！
TEXT.German: Dieser Ort macht überhaupt keinen Spaß und die roten Jungs haben meine Spielsachen kaputt gemacht. Ich werde woanders eine Prinzessin sein!

TEXT.English: 死者不自悲而为生者所悲。我将为谁所悲？
TEXT.German: Die Toten weinen nicht, sondern werden beweint. Mal sehen, wer um mich weint.

TEXT.English: 没人能抵挡衰竭的命运——除了那些吞噬它的永生者。
TEXT.German: Niemand kann die Entropie aufhalten. Nur das, was andere verzehrt, ist ewig.

TEXT.English: 我是在高贵的卡姆罗斯地狱里建造的，你们这些次等生物居然能打败我？
TEXT.German: Ich wurde in in Camulos' Hölle geschmiedet. Wie könnten mich niedere Wesen besiegen?

TEXT.English: 我将深深怀念着我的宫殿。厄瑞波斯大陆上还从没有那座宫殿能够像它那样充满着残忍和野蛮。
TEXT.German: Ich werde meinen Palast am meisten vermissen. Erebus ist niemals Zeuge eines großartigeren Monuments der Verderbtheit und der Grausamkeit geworden als jenes, das ich entworfen habe.

TEXT.English: 你从我手中夺去欲望不过是为了自己享受罢了。没人愿意放弃权力，这正是阿加雷斯带给我们的枷锁——新恶魔领主的崛起意味着旧领主的衰亡。
TEXT.German: Ihr nehmt mir dieses Verlangen nur, um es Euch selbst zu eigen zu machen. Niemand wendet sich von der Macht ab. Es ist die Leine, mit der uns Agares an sich bindet. Wo ein Dämonenfürst versagt, steigt ein anderer auf.

TEXT.English: 塔利亚……可恨我现在太过弱小，没法为你复仇了。
TEXT.German: Talia... ich war zu schwach, um Euch zu rächen.

TEXT.English: 剧情描述：带领你的军团进入下级魔殿，帮助它们摧毁魔王的统治。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]奖励：完成这个任务可以削弱全部其他剧情里的地狱军团实力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]前提条件：完成光辉守卫剧情和罪恶的酬劳剧情。
TEXT.German: Beschreibung: Führt Eure Armee in den Tempel der Unbedeutenden und zerstört den Höllenthron.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Besondere Regeln: Die Auswirkungen auf den Armageddonzähler werden verdoppelt, aber durch die Zerstörung von Nekrototems sinkt er auch wieder.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Belohnung: Bei erfolgreichem Abschluss dieses Szenarios verringert sich die Stärke der Infernalen in allen anderen Szenarien.

TEXT.English: 通道看起来已被废弃多时。你的军队通过时，依然可以见到少许灵魂在高墙的壁龛间游荡。他们本是为了逃避他们的恶魔领主才躲在这里，现在你的军队使他们也可能被暴露出来——因此他们十分愤怒。
TEXT.German: Dieser Pass scheint verlassen zu sein. Als Eure Armee ihn passiert, bemerkt Ihr einige Geister, die zwischen den verschiedenen Nischen der Steilwand hin und her schweben. Sie verstecken sich hier vor ihren dämonischen Herren und sind erzürnt, dass Eure Durchquerung vielleicht die Aufmerksamkeit auf sie lenken wird.

TEXT.English: The souls hiding in this pass are cowards hiding from their demonic lords. At first they mistook Keelyn for a succubus queen and fled. Keelyn, curious to see what these timid shapes bounding away in terror are, ordered a few of them captured. Upon capture, one of the souls struggled for words.[PARAGRAPH:1]"Your malevolence," he began, "we are of no interest to you... let us be, we are unworthy."[PARAGRAPH:1]"I will," Keelyn responded, "if you agree to be good little spirits and serve me."[PARAGRAPH:1]"We have always served you and your masters, lady..." one of the souls stammered.[PARAGRAPH:1]Keelyn took out a runic knife and sliced the spirit, which screamed in pain.[PARAGRAPH:1]"I don't have a master," Keelyn said, "and soon these lands will be mine. I don't have to follow anyone's rules."[PARAGRAPH:1]"Very well, than we kneel before you... as... the new Queen of the Fane of the Lessers, glorious mistress of..." another slice, another scream of pain.[PARAGRAPH:1]"I prefer Princess of the Fane. Queens are old and tired, princesses are young and pretty. And forget the Lessers, it doesn't sound very impressive."[PARAGRAPH:1]"Yes, yes... whatever you wish... you are the Princess of the Fane, your beauty is beyond words, your power is beyond our mere comprehension, just please don't hurt us."[PARAGRAPH:1]"I won't, if you do one thing."[PARAGRAPH:1]"Why, anything, your grace!"[PARAGRAPH:1]"I'm bored. Sing me a song." With a casual spin of a dagger, she adds, "and make sure it's a good one."
火焰墙阻止了你的部队前进的步伐，你的部队不得不停下灭火才得以继续前进。
击败剩下的%d1个恶魔
TEXT.German: Besiegt [NUM1:den:die] verbleibenden %d1 [NUM1:Dämonenfürst:Dämonenfürsten]

TEXT.English: 我想我已经彻底的迷上了涤荡邪恶的战争……我是众神之战中最后的战士，我将以我之力，让这场战争在厄瑞波斯大陆上延续下去。穿过每一处村庄和原野，直至恶魔要塞甚至地狱本身。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]但我不是傻瓜，我知道人类不可相信。他们软弱，短视，且易于背叛。他们会为了可笑而微不足道的理由出卖一切美德。但是仍有两点值得注意：厄瑞波斯是人类的世界，由于众神契约的存在，我不能轻易的进入这个世界；而且我的天使一旦死亡就彻底消失，而人类的数量似乎无穷无尽。因此我的胜利还是需要仰赖人类的存在。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]并且，在这一代人类中，我看到了一些希望：一方面，一些人追随着大天使萨巴曦尔，成功逃离了地狱。现在他们准备继续向下级魔殿进发，以拯救一些失踪很久的同伴。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]另一方面，没骨气的光明之神罗格斯，手下却有一个高级祭祀，带领着马拉基姆游牧民，为了复仇而向魔殿进军。虽然我总是疑惑于人类会把注意力只集中在少数几个灵魂，而并非拯救这个世界上，但总的来说，他的行动目标与我一致；这没有坏处。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]不管怎么说，我已经注意魔殿很久了，就像注意着充满狼群的森林的牧羊人一样。我将加入这两只部队，因为这些部队的士兵都因为魔殿而失去了自己所爱，所以他们会全身心的投入到战斗中去；即使死亡也会变为天使而重新加入我的阵营。班诺尔联邦和马拉基姆游牧民或许只有能力拖住地狱军团一小会儿，但我将会为这次战争画上休止符。

凯布瑞尔在自己的尖叫声中惊醒，她花费了数秒钟才将自己的思绪从梦境中调整了过来。这里只有她一个人，但刚才的梦境仍在她脑海中回荡，梦境里是那个逃离地狱的传送门，神子卢乌在门的对面，他被永远的困在了地狱之中；但凯布瑞尔仍然可以感到他在呼唤着她。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]全副武装的卫兵冲进了大门[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“凯布瑞尔女士，发生了什么事吗？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]她稳了稳情绪，虽然她仍然心有余悸、大汗淋漓，但现在的她是他们的领袖，她不能表现出软弱。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“我很好，你们回自己的岗位吧。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]士兵们道歉后离开了房间，但刚才的梦境却挥之不去。她继续睡觉，这次她又梦见了卢乌，但不是在传送门附近，而是一块被污染的大地上。那里被山脉环绕，但可以确定的一点就是那片土地处在厄瑞波斯大陆上而不是地狱中。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]早上醒来时，她已知道如何去做。失踪已久的卢乌还活着，而且已经逃出了地狱。她迅速打扮整齐，前往船坞。她需要一艘大帆船和一些部队，她将消灭所有挡在她和班诺尔联邦史上最伟大英雄之间的恶魔。

“我又要得到一个新宠物，”某天，琪琳公主快乐的说，“别担心，查克斯，你依然是我最喜欢的——只是今天这个也将会特别有趣。”她快乐的蹦蹦跳跳的下了楼梯，到达了她专门用来召唤的小室。[NEWLINE]「心配しないで、チャクルス。あなたは私のお气に入りのままよ。でもこの新しい子は本当に乐しみだわ！」[NEWLINE] 彼女は飞び跳ねながら、待ち切れないように召唤部屋へと阶段を降りてゆきました。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 彼女の新しい魔法圆は、私が今まで见た中で一番大きなものでした。いつも彼女が呼び出すのは、インプであったりバロールであったり、ときどきは精灵であったりしました。しかしこの新しい魔法圆は、彼女が私を呼び出したものさえ上回る大きさでした。私はそのときのことをはっきりと觉えています。私はとても怒りに满ちており、それから憎しみを抱いていました。しかしキーリン样は私に幸せであることを教えました。そして私は幸せでした。私は今彼女に仕え、私がお痛をしない限り、彼女は私によくしてくれました。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 私はそこに书かれたルーン文字を调べました。それはこう读めました……「ハイボレム」。その名前は闻いたことがありました……。私はよく思い出そうとしました。しかし、その嫌な日々を觉えているのは难しいことでした。でもその名前は……何かの理由があって、私には恐ろしいものでした。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]「谁を呼び出すのですか、ご主人样？」と私は寻ねました。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]「私はお父样の书库でこのご本を读んでいたの。それによれば、恶魔の中で一番大っきいのはハイボレムなんですって。だからそれを呼び出すのよ。」[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] ハイボレム。なぜだかそれは良くない考えだと思えました。キーリン样が呼び出した他のすべての恶魔たちは、新たな主人を爱することを觉えました。でも何か理由があって、私は心配でした。ハイボレムはその嫌な日々の中で确かに恐ろしい存在でした。私の恐ろしさなど足元にも及ばないほどに。キーリン样が指を鸣らすと、操り人形たちがガタンと摇れて动き出しました。彼らはキーリン样が召唤咒文を咏うのに合わせて踊り始めました。そしてバロールたちを统べる王が、我らの前に现れました。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] ハイボレムは大柄でした。本当に巨大でした。彼はかろうじて召唤の魔法圆の中に收まっていました。彼は戒めに抗って咆哮しました。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]「我が宫殿より我を召唤せしは何者だ？どんな死すべき定めの者が尊大にも……」彼は视线を下げました。[NEWLINE]「なんだこれは？幼き少女、それも狂气と冒渎の混血とは。これは恶くない捧げものだ。我を解き放て。生贽を顶いて、贵样の命运を决めてやる。贵样の苦痛なぞほんのひと时のものだ、今は生かしておいてやる。觉えておけ……次に我を呼び出すときは、愿いを乞え、命令は许さん。」[NEWLINE] ハイボレムは私を见ると仁王立ちになりました。[NEWLINE]「贵样！生贽を我に投げて寄越せ、それから我を呼び出した愚かな魔术师の姿を暴くのだ。」[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]「なぜ汝は我に命令するのか？」と私は问いました。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] ハイボレムは睨んできました。彼は魔法圆を苛みました。戒めが彼を闭じ込めているという事实は、ハイボレムを激昂させるだけでした。[NEWLINE]「贵样は图々しくも自らの主に疑问を寄越すのか？」[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]「违う、」と私は言いました。「我が仕えるのはキーリン姬だ。」[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] ハイボレムは私を见て、角に卷かれたピンクのちょうちょ结びに气付き、それからキーリンの发を留めるちょうちょ结びにちらりと目を遣りました。彼は召唤の魔法圆が许す限りその颜をキーリンの近くまで寄せました。[NEWLINE]「Pedicabo ego vos et irrumabo.（お前らのカマ掘ってからそのマラしゃぶらせてやるぞ） エレバスの历史において、贵样ほど尊大な奴はおらなんだわ。我がしもべを夺い、そのうえ我をただのインプも同然に呼び出すだと？」[NEWLINE] 再び、ハイボレムは魔法圆を打ち据えました。しかしキーリン姬の魔法圆は持ちこたえました。彼は念りました。[NEWLINE]「贵样に见合うだけの恐ろしさを秘めた苦闷は、地狱にもないわ。地狱の底の排泄物で窒息させてやる。贵样はふしだらな淫卖が流した、泣き叫ぶ水子で溢れる穴ぐらの中で年月を过ごすのだ。新しい罚を考案してやる、贵样のためにだぞ……それとそこの逆らった马鹿者もだ。」[NEWLINE] そう言うと、ハイボレムは咒文を玄いて消灭しました。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]「彼はどこに行ったの？」とキーリンは问いました。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 私は记忆を探りました。[NEWLINE]「劣りし者の魔殿です、」と私は答えました。意味はまったく分かりませんでしたが。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] キーリン样は阶段を驱け上がり、パーペンタクの大臣二人に出会いました。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]「姬样、」と一人が言いました。[NEWLINE]「我らはあなたがこんなにも早く实行にお移しになるとは思いもしませんでしたぞ。」[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]「新しいペットは逃げちゃったわ、」とキーリンは言いました。[NEWLINE]「だからお仕置きに行かなきゃ。」[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]「どこに行ったのです？」ともう一人の大臣が寻ねました。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]「劣りし者の魔殿よ。その子の名前はハイボレムっていうの。ものすごく口が恶いのよ。」[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 大臣たちは互いを凝视しました。[NEWLINE]「彼自身の领域までハイボレムを追うおつもりですか？なぜって……彼はお茶会を乐しんだりなんてしませんよ！？杀されてしまいま……」别の大臣がみぞおちに肘铁を入れました。[NEWLINE] 彼らは何かを企むような目つきで、互いに目配せし合いました。彼らは嗫き声で简单に话を济ませると、怪しげな微笑みを浮かべてこう言いました。[NEWLINE]「ガレオン船の手配をいたしましょう、それと……任务のための志愿兵を募らなくては……あなたをお助けするための。」[NEWLINE] 我々が去ると、私は一人が玄くのを间违いなく闻きました。[NEWLINE]「姬样が成功なされたらどうする气だ？」[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]もう一人が忍び笑いを漏らしました。[NEWLINE]「心配するな。彼女はもう死んだも同然だ。」

我早已原谅了她，但她却不肯原谅自己。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]她常在黄昏时祈祷。她对于黄昏的敬仰，正如我对黎明的敬畏。她常说当这个世界睡着时，灵魂会离开身体四处游荡。因此她总是很晚睡觉，靠着自己召唤出的火焰取暖；闻着神庙的灵石旁的向日葵的芬芳度过夜晚。她是如此美丽，我深爱着她。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]我某天早晨起床，发现她一夜都没有睡觉。这时距离她在泪水中告诉我她曾犯下的错误正好三天。我发誓我将忘却她所犯下的错误，重新相信她。但这天看着空空的床铺我有了不妙的感觉。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]我在她的灵石前找到了她的尸体。她因为使用了超出自己精神力的法术，灵魂已经消逝，而这一切只是因为她放弃了活下去的念头。在她身边，我找到了一张小纸条，上面简单的写着：“对不起”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]她已经无法救治。我再一次在罗格斯大人神殿前流下了泪水，有天使降临安慰着我。我们一起给了塔利亚一个神圣的告别。她是如此的憎恨着她曾带给我的痛苦，并祈求能为我补偿什么。我的伤痛只能由时间和耐心来治疗，但这时，另一个声音带给了我一个更直接的解决方案。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]悲痛女王莱丝，是她诱惑了塔利亚，正如她之前已重复过的一千次一样，诱使她放弃自己的生命，从而忘记痛苦。塔利亚相信了她，自杀于神庙，希望能减少她带给我的痛苦。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]现在，我正向一个美丽的海滩航行，海浪拍打着一个巨大山脉脚下的礁石。想不到下级魔殿，阿加雷斯在大陆上的巢穴，灵魂最初堕落的地方，竟然就在这个山脉的背后。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]就凭我目前的一点追随者，去攻打恶魔的要塞，看起来是有些疯狂。但我知道，莱丝就在这个丑恶山脉的深处，我要将莱丝、她的声音、和她的一切追随者，从厄瑞波斯大陆上抹去。
对光明之神[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]罗格斯[COLOR_REVERT]的崇拜已经传遍了你的人民。他们聚集在你的旗帜下并自愿帮助你对抗地狱军团。
TEXT.German: Der Glaube an Lugus, den Gott der Morgendämmerung, verbreitet sich unter Eurem Volk. Sie versammeln sich unter Eurem Banner und bieten Euch ihre Unterstützung für Euren Krieg gegen die Infernalen an.

TEXT.English: 你不是一个人在战斗！绝对秩序的信徒们给你带来了忠贞不移的部队。
TEXT.German: Ihr seid nicht allein. Die Weisung entsendet Soldaten zu Eurer Unterstützung. Es sind unerschütterliche und loyale Truppen.

TEXT.English: 一个祭祀和一对被海水浸渍的人在海浪中玩耍。是好奇将他们引到了你的城市。他们说着一些奇怪的故事，你决定留下他们，尽管他们的味道有点奇怪。
TEXT.German: Ein Priester und zwei salzverkrustete Männer spielen in der Meeresbrandung. Die Neugier treibt sie in Eure Stadt, wo sie merkwürdige Geschichten erzählen. Ihr entscheidet sie bleiben zu lassen, obwohl sie komisch riechen.

TEXT.English: 这条通道被自杀而产生的灵魂占据着，通道两边悬崖高耸。每到夜里，不愿回归魔殿的灵魂都会聚集到这里，度过它们生命的最后一刻。还有许多灵魂被悬挂在悬崖上的尖角处，在永恒的痛苦中挣扎着。[NEWLINE]一个身着淡色服装的女孩，从高崖上尖叫着坠下，狠狠的砸在你兵士的面前，但马上她又重新出现在了高崖上，继续着这一幕。一位满面瘀伤的母亲，在周围孩子的哭声中，喝下了一个小瓶中的药剂，从此沉睡不起。

巴尔塞拉弗族的士兵被恶魔莱丝的歌声所吸引；那是一首夹杂着现世的痛苦和残酷、以及遗忘过去的美好和轻松的歌谣。一些士兵不由自主的想听从她的召唤，另一些则感到了刺骨的寒意——但尽管这歌谣如此可怕，不得不说它依然充满了美感。[NEWLINE]可琪琳却不为所动，她说：“她唱得不错，比我的鸟儿好多了。把她带来，我要让她成为我新的小鸟。另外，赶快做一个更大的笼子，原来的那个对她来说太小了。”[NEWLINE]意志最强的士兵，出于对琪琳的敬畏和对巨角炎魔的恐惧，开始准备执行他们公主的意志。而那些聪明的，则装作寻找笼子的材料的样子，并借此逃避开即将来临的战斗。至于那些依然被迷惑的，琪琳给其中一个释放了诅咒。但他实在是太入神以至于没有注意到这个咒语...直到琪琳激活了诅咒，给他带来了难以想象的痛苦，即让他无法死去，又无法昏迷。他尖叫着，从塞壬歌声中清醒过来。

这条通道被自杀而产生的灵魂占据着，通道两边悬崖高耸。每到夜里，不愿回归魔殿的灵魂都会聚集到这里，度过它们生命的最后一刻。还有许多灵魂被悬挂在悬崖上的尖角处，在永恒的痛苦中挣扎着。[NEWLINE]一个身着淡色服装的女孩，从高崖上尖叫着坠下，狠狠的砸在你兵士的面前，但马上她又重新出现在了高崖上，继续着这一幕。一位满面瘀伤的母亲，在周围孩子的哭声中，喝下了一个小瓶中的药剂，从此沉睡不起。[NEWLINE]你在想塔利亚是否已经通过了这条通道。你的士兵们为每一个死难者祈祷，但这种祈祷毫无作用。莱丝的低语毁掉的生命比你拥有的还多。
穆尔卡恩重生
TEXT.German: Mulcarns Wiedergeburt

TEXT.English: 连那些可怜的勤杂工都能召集比你更强大的力量来攻击我。现在我已经真正重生，你则已被这个世界抛弃。

Commander Achare led the hunters personally; he wanted to see the lay of the land of a site that would almost certainly be a battlefield in the coming weeks. He didn't know that they were walking into a Doviello ambush—but that wouldn't have stopped him. Life was struggle, and Bannor commanders don't survive it by leading from the rear. They survive it by being very good fighters as well as leaders.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]And by being lucky when they need to be. A horde of Sons of Asena sprang from the woods, icy winds at their back. The Bannor hunters formed ranks quickly, sending in their wolves to skirmish as they fired at their attackers with short bows. Doviello men were not deterred by charging wolves, and the Bannor prepared to go down fighting.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]But the Doviello stopped their charge, turned and faced new threat from behind them. Emerging from the darkness came Moroi, the savage foot soldiers of the Calabim. The Doviello were quickly dispatched, as the Moroi matched their ferocity with surprise.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Bannor commander kept his men alert. Though they hadn't had a reason to enter Calabim lands, he wasn't ignorant of the world. The Calabim were monsters, and he would happily lead a crusade into their cities if ordered. Worse, they had sided with the Sheaim and Infernal in Tempus Mor, the very battle he had been training to join when Auric led his armies into Torolerial and sacked the great city, seemingly slaying the Bannor leader Sabathiel in the process. But no blood had been spilled between them yet, and he awaited some announcement from their saviors.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Men of the Bannor," the Calabim commander began, emerging from the ranks of his soldiers, then stopped. "Well. Hello father."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Samatheon Achare froze, seeing his fugitive son Decius before him. "So. This is where you ended up. I must admit that after we discovered your innocence I hoped you were still alive... but I think death would have been preferable to this."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Innocent?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Yes. Well, innocent of witchcraft and blasphemy. Guilty of knocking out three of your father's teeth with an idol. It was planted by Arret, Rosier's uncle. We found out he was a necromancer and veil disciple during the sack of Torolerial. It seems he framed you to throw off suspicion aroused by Rosier's betrayal."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"So it took the near destruction of your beloved nation to show you the error of your ways."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"What? We face a setback, but our whole history has been one pitched battle, Decius, you know that. I do not apologize for what transpired between us. You should have come along and faced trial rather than assault me and flee. How were we to take that other than as a confirmation of guilt?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"A trial would have found me innocent?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Probably. Possibly not. Sometimes innocents suffer; this is a consequence of the imperfection of our world. Law and order are the only way for society to function, and guilty must pay, even if occasionally an innocent is blamed."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Decius said, "Blood means nothing to you?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"I've shed tears for you already Decius, but I will weaken my civilization to favor my own children. Why are you here? To strike your revenge while we are weakened?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Hardly. From what I hear, the last Ice age was rather hard on the Calabim who make up my imperial troops. I aim to prevent the next one."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Commander Achare sheathed his sword and turned his back. "Then we are allies, for a time."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"And after?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Most certainly not. You lead a band of murderers, and bring dishonor on your family. I hope you fall in battle, son, there is little other hope of your redemption now."

Commander Achare led the hunters personally; he wanted to see the lay of the land of a site that would almost certainly be a battlefield in the coming weeks. He didn't know that they were walking into a Doviello ambush—but that wouldn't have stopped him. Life was struggle, and Bannor commanders don't survive it by leading from the rear. They survive it by being very good fighters as well as leaders.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]And by being lucky when they need to be. A horde of Sons of Asena sprang from the woods, icy winds at their back. The Bannor hunters formed ranks quickly, sending in their wolves to skirmish as they fired at their attackers with short bows. Doviello men were not deterred by charging wolves, and the Bannor prepared to go down fighting.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]But the Doviello stopped their charge, turned and faced a new threat from behind them. Malakim warriors, dressed for the arctic battle in lion fur coats, descended upon the Doviello. The wild men turn on them in a rage, but the newcomers to the Aquillo tundra hold their lines, showing a discipline matching the Bannor's. The Bannor commander ordered his hunters to strike, and the Doviello ambush is turned to a rout, with Malakim cavalry chasing down the survivors.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Commander Samatheon Achare stepped forward to offer thanks to their saviors, but stopped when he saw who stepped out to greet him. "I see the Bannor sent their best to stop the end of the world."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Decius? By Junil, I had feared you dead."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"No. I am not dead. I have traveled the ends of the earth to seek refuge from false accusations, but I live and am better for it."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"False accusations. Not false, for I accused you in good faith, but wrong nonetheless. Arret, Roiser's uncle, was revealed a necromancer in the sacking of Torolerial. But the evidence before my eyes could not be ignored. A man cannot show favoritism to his own kin over the rule of law—that is the way of anarchy and tyranny. I have long grieved for what transpired between us—that you would see your own father as your persecutor, that the promise your life showed should be wasted."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"I understand. I cannot say I regret my flee from justice, but I absolve you. The Bannor notion of righteousness is lacking—incomplete. But you served me well in my youth, and gave me a love of goodness and honor that I was able to preserve, despite everything. My time with the Malakim, these men who now follow me, allowed me to grasp the complete vision—justice paired with redemption and reconciliation. It will be good to speak of these matters further with you, should we survive this war with Auric."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Yes. Although it would be best for you to avoid the Bannor lands. You are not a heretic, but you did strike your commanding officer."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Uncompromising even as the fate of the world hangs in the balance?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"How else do you think we survived this long, my son? I am glad to see you in a good place. But do not expect us to change, not so fast. Perhaps as we work with your Overcouncil, we can test these new ideas that Varn Gosam is teaching. Well. We must report back, and lady Capria will be pleased to hear that you are here supporting us. Be well."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"And you," Decius replied, before turning back to his army.
阁下驯服了支配我的那个精灵；我感激不已，即使你的行为也将我带向死亡。
TEXT.German: Ihr habt den Geist bezähmt, der mich beherrscht hat. Obwohl Ihr mir den Tod bringt, danke ich Euch dafür.

TEXT.English: 不论生死，我等待的只是奥里克大人作为冬神的重生。你改变不了这一切。
TEXT.German: Egal ob lebendig oder tot, ich warte nur auf Aurics Geburt als Gott des Winters. Das könnt Ihr nicht verhindern.

TEXT.English: 班诺尔联邦永远坚持到底——但很不幸我们已经达到了底线。
TEXT.German: Die Bannor werden bis zum Ende ausharren, doch dieser Punkt ist nun erreicht.

TEXT.English: 我的军队消灭了就消灭了吧，反正我可以轻易的从布里斯波的饲养场里再召集一批。
TEXT.German: Lasst meine Armee untergehen. Ich werden eine andere in den Gruben von Prespur ausheben.

TEXT.English: 夜晚降临；马拉基姆也沦陷了
TEXT.German: Wir gehen ins Dunkel. Die Malakim sind besiegt.

TEXT.English: 白龙已经准备出发，我只是遗憾没看见它消灭你时的英姿。
TEXT.German: Der Weiße Drache harrt Eurer. Ich bin nur traurig, dass ich nicht sehen werde, wie er Euch heimsucht.

TEXT.English: 他太强了，我不得不撤退了，朋友。
TEXT.German: Er ist zu stark. Ich kann Euch nicht weiter begleiten, mein Freund.

TEXT.English: 多维洛部落结束了，这个时代再无我们的容身之地。
TEXT.German: Die Doviello sind besiegt. Für sie gibt es in diesem Zeitalter keinen Platz mehr.

TEXT.English: 希普斯人会被仅仅一个人打败？塔松克，我不在时，复仇的大业就交给你了。
TEXT.German: Werden alle Hippus einem Mann zum Opfer fallen? Ihr müsst Tasunke ohne mich rächen.

TEXT.English: 你也终将如我一样被愤怒烧尽，冬天不会结束。
TEXT.German: Wettere gegen mich solange du willst. Der Winter wird nicht enden.

TEXT.English: 夏之女王奴役了我；这不是我想走的道路。
TEXT.German: Die Sommerkönigin hat mich versklavt. Dies war niemals der Weg, den ich gehen wollte.

TEXT.English: 剧情描述：奥里克即将作为冬神的化身降临这个世界。如果你不想让厄瑞波斯大陆重新陷入冰河时代的话，你必须阻止他的仪式。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]特殊要求：你会被强制改变你所控制的文明，去控制你的组队中最弱小的一家。所以，你要平衡好各家的实力，如果某家变得极其虚弱时你却不去救援，当你转为控制那家时你可能会后悔！[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]条件: 完成黑暗之塔、仪式和灰色的反叛剧情。
TEXT.German: Beschreibung: Auric hat vor, zu einer Gottheit aufzusteigen. Wenn Ihr Erebus vor einem weiteren Zeitalter des Eises bewahren wollt, müsst Ihr ihn aufhalten.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Besondere Regeln: Ihr werdet die Führung Eures schwächsten Verbündeten übernehmen. Ihr müsst die Kräfte eurer Einheiten zusammen koordinieren, denn, falls einer der Verbündeten untergeht, werdet Ihr wahrscheinlich gerade dessen Führung inne haben.

TEXT.English: %d1回合后转变领袖
TEXT.German: Wechsel der Zivilisation in %d1 [NUM1:Runde:Runden]

TEXT.English: Across the Aquilo Tundra leaders sat in war rooms staring at scattered maps on long tables. Rhoanna was determined and anxious, pushing her captains to make immediate attacks against the Doviello and the Illians before they prepare their defenses. Capria, always aware of the threat of over extension, advised her captains to carefully guard their foothold on Auric's island and expand slowly. Falamar landed offshore from the Tundra so that he could train units and launch attacks without fear of direct retaliation.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Their enemies were no different. Riuros, Anagantios and Dumannios had little concern for the meager boats that landed on their shores, but Lucian took the invasion more seriously and he was glad to see Mahala arrive with more soldiers.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"You have done well." Mahala said, "News of your victories has drawn many Doviello from the wastes looking for blood, or to be nearby when Auric's rewards are handed out."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]She paused, looking through one of her supply chests for a belt of short knives, before asking, "Is it true that Cassiel is dead?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Yes. Midgar burned to the ground and their king was sacrificed in one of Auric's rituals."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"If the stories are true then you and the Illian commanders are the first to witness the death of an archangel. What was it like?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Lucian shifted uncomfortably, "He died poorly, chained like a dog and serving his enemies purpose in his death instead of his own."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Let us hope that we fare better than he did." Mahala said half-joking, but Lucian remained quiet.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"I have been to Auric's capital." Mahala said, switching the subject, "I have seen the pillar of light from his ritual, felt the welling power of a god soon to be born, and watched the dragon circling the city. It is hard to imagine that Auric will not succeed, and if he does we are best to be on his side when he does. Are these your thoughts as well?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Lucian considered. He was a powerful man among the Doviello, strong, clever and brutal. Although very capable, there were thousands of men like him across Erebus. Those born among the Lanun became pirates living on the edges of their society, their lawlessness made them feared by victims and fellow pirates alike, and outcasts from their own society. Among the Bannor men like him were quickly imprisoned or sent to the gallows. Success isn't a result of talent alone, but of your talents value in your society. One society's general is another's criminal, one society's artist is another's madman.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Yes." Lucian answered, "The Doviello cannot live in this world, we must return to an older one if we are to flourish."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Very well, we have only to scatter these fledgling armies until Auric completes his ritual. Then we will return to our more primal world."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Falamar never imagined himself as a commander of anything but his own ship. For him supply lines were something to be intercepted and pilfered, not guarded. A treasury should finance nights of excess, not a growing war.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"We have delivered Rhoanna to the war." Amergin offered.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]It was as close as loyal Amergin ever came to questioning his captain, the implication that they had earned some rest after their defeat of Tebryn in the dead lands.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Yes, I suppose we have. But if she defeats Auric, what sort of victory will it be, and how can we miss the opportunity to participate in such legends." Falamar answered.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"We have gone from hunting wolves to demonic armies, played parts in the Momus's crazed game and watched our brothers reborn as undead before our eyes. These may be legends, but there is little glory in them."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Falamar nodded. "And is she fails, what then? What sort of world will it be? Can even the Black Wind sail fast enough to escape the grip of eternal winter, or will we all share Malus's fate?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"No." Amergin answered, "The Lanun could not survive in that world, we must save this one."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Amergin paused before adding, "Forgive my ramblings, I am ever at your side. I have been away from my rum for too long, and it muddies my thoughts."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Falamar smiled, placing two cups on the table and pulling a small cast from beneath it. He poured them both drinks as he smiled adding, "Or perhaps your time sober has made your thoughts too clear, that is never a good trait for a soldier."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]They laughed, toasted and drank into the night, sharing stories and planning for the hard days ahead.
TEXT.German: Bald!

TEXT.English: %s1_civ需要你的帮助，你需要带领他们对抗奥里克。
TEXT.German: Die %s1_civ benötigen Eure Hilfe. Ihr müsst sie gegen Auric in den Kampf führen.

TEXT.English: The Illian capital is a ring of military buildings around a massive pillar of pale white light. An intense cold radiates out from the light, frosting exposed flesh and reaching through the thickest furs to chill bones and freeze the breath. The Illian defenders are quickly cut down, they refuse to retreat into the pillar, seeming more afraid of what lies within it than the advancing army.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The capture of the city doesn't stop the ritual. Everyone can feel the welling power, the proximity to a powerful, divine, malevolent force. A few archers lob arrows into the pillar without effect, fire spells dissipate uselessly.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Decius sticks the Nether Blade through the veil of light, when he withdrawls it it is cold to the touch by undamaged. He shealths the sword and goes back to where the commanders discuss a plan. With no good options Rhoanna breaks the stalemate. In one quick motion she pulls the Nether Blade from Decius's belt and charges into the light.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Stepping into the pillar is like entering a new world. Primal winds howl and the light is replaced with the white of a raging blizzard. Everything is white, and what was the flat ground of the city center is replaced with a steep mountainous slope.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Rhoanna crawls forward, she can feel the cold air tearing through her, like she has swallowed knives. Through the sleet of white she gets occasional glimpses of a steep mountainside behind her, and beyond a vast black swamp. Other howls give evidence that she isn't alone on the slope but she keeps climbing.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Her arms and legs go past cold, go past numb and start feeling warm. She is only sure she still drags the Nether Blade along with her because she can see it in her hand. Dreams begin to overcome her, the soft grasslands of her home, the feel of a saddle beneath her, the warmth of Falamar's bed.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]She stops moving, seeing another world around her as a frost giant lumbers out of the storm. Unwilling to smash such a nice meal he picks up the freezing Rhoanna in one giant fist. She curls up in his hand, then in a flash of clarity realizes where she is and stabs out with the sword, piercing his neck and sending the giant falling backwards. He is dead before he hits the ground. Determined, Rhoanna pulls the sword out of his neck and once again begins her ascent.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]It is only a few hundred feet, but it feels like miles. By the time she can see the peak her arms and legs refuse to obey her. But she can see Auric standing on the peak unaffected by the raging blizzard around him. Around him, around the mountain itself, a god rages.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Auric looks at the woman staggering towards him. He is transcendiant, a man at his most powerful, almost a god against a woman who is too stubborn to die. He smiles.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]For Tasunke she thinks, she tries to scream it but she can't muster the breath to force the words through frozen lips. She promises her body, one last rush and she will allow it to die, just another 20 feet. She staggers closer as Auric raises a hand and says, "Slow...",[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Everything stops, her heart beats stretch out weak and thin, even falling to her knees takes seconds and that last breath out of her body goes on for much longer. Her hair whips around her head at a slower rate than the wind and she simply stares at it in confusion.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Then blue eyes command her attention. Falamar places his hands over hers, tightening her grip on the sword. She can see the pain and cold in his eyes, the strain of pushing your body past its limits, the knowledge that you are already dead but still pressing on. But still he smiles and pulls her up onto her feet with the Nether Blade between them.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Auric looks irritated, as Rhoanna and Falamar charge forward he simply says, "Snowfall".[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]A wall of snow so thick even Auric is blinded by it explodes out of him, but it does not stop them. Pushing through wall of ice the sword holds and they both jam it deeply into Auric's chest. For a second there is no sound on the mountaintop as Auric stands confused. Then he screams, a scream that is echoed by the spirit of the god above him and thousands of frost spirits that hunt the mountain. Then it is all gone.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]In the Illian capital the light recedes into the bone colored sky leaving Rhoanna and Falamar lying alone in the center. Hippus and Lanun commanders rush in, calling for priests.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Don't think this gets you out of owing me a ship." Rhoanna quips as priests tended to both of them.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"I keep telling you, that was my brother-in-law." Falamar responds.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Night falls on combined armies, but no one sleeps. They are beyond tired, but still talk, laugh and celebrate on the tundra. And even a few of the Bannor soliders relax and tell a few jokes, a sure sign that it must be a new age on Erebus.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]--- Epilogue ---[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Ethne played beneath the Tulip Poplar tree. She could see the palace through a veil of fog and hear the distant sounds of the city beyond the palace grounds. Somewhere within the gardens other child ran and played, but she could not see them.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]This place, this dream, wrapped itself tightly around her. It was easy to believe. But nagging thoughts, the trials and pains of her life, would not let her rest. She was not a child, she was the ruler of an empire she loved, she had taken that empire to war, seen countless good soldiers die and she had been the victim of an assassins attack.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]It was this last thought that jarred her from the dream. That attack, the dark blade that stole her life and carried her soul to this place. She could see it clearly now, she was a child no more.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The shape of a palace obscured by fog remained, as did the spirits of children playing in the field. The Tulip Poplar tree was gone, until she looked for it, and then it reappeared. She wore a beautiful mourning gown, which is traditional for burial among the Elohim, but Ethne suspected it wasn't real either.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]As Ethne walked she found other spirits trapped within their own dreams, playing, sleeping or talking quietly to empty air. They seemed peaceful enough so she didn't disturb them. There was no wall around the palace grounds as she had imagined, and no city beyond, only the hazy surface of this world and a labyrinth of passages to chambers full of other dreams.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]It was impossible to tell how long she walked. Some places were pleasant, a field of flowers and wild birds, a pond where a boy and a large yellow dog played together, a mother who eternally sung to her child. Others were darker, a shadowy forest inhabited by glowing moths, a cellar where Ethne heard crying but couldn't find anyone, a lost child calling eternally for help. And some of the chambers were just strange, there was a city that ran backwards, an empty carnival where spirits ran and hid from each other and a galleon coming straight out of the ground crewed by souls ever looking unsuccessfully for land.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Eventually Ethne wandered onto a small farm. A single barn stood on a field that had been recently harvested, the barn itself was well stocked with grain and the smell of freshly cut wheat filled the air. A man sat on a chair in front of the barn looking at a distant village, barely visible beyond the haze.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The man looked at Ethne as she approached.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"None of it is real." He said.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"I know" Ethne replied startled, "did you grow up on this farm?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Yes, on a farm like this."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Shackles snaked up through the ground and clasp onto the man wrists. Ethne turned to run but another pair grabbed her. They were both pulled through the surface of the ground, into a world without light, substance or breath. When they came out they were dropped into a summoning circle in a large vaulted ivory chamber. A man with a crown of mirrors and deep black pits instead of eyes stared at both of them. A blue skinned angel stood beside him and around the room hundreds of humans, elves, dwarves and orcs stood watching. Ethne knew they were all great people from many ages, kings and heroes.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Ethne. Auric." The man without eyes said, "Welcome to my palace. There are only two choices in the world of the dead, you wait endlessly, or you rebel. I am the leader of that rebellion, I am Laroth."
TEXT.German: Bald!

TEXT.English: 冬之再来
TEXT.German: Rückkehr des Winters

TEXT.English: 库里奥塔特人的忠诚是令人敬佩的，但这使他们变得软弱。如此顺从的民族会向多维洛部落恐吓实在令人惊讶。但是他们殷实国库证明他们获得了好处，你可以从他们的国库中掠夺250金币。
TEXT.German: Die Loyalität der Kuriotate ist bewundernswert, aber sie hat sie auch weich gemacht. Ihr fragt Euch, wie solch ein nachgiebiges Volk jemals eine Gefahr für die Doviello darstellen konnte. Aber ihre Schatzkammern zeigen die Vorzüge ihrer Haltung, als Ihr 250 Gold ihres Staatsschatzes findet.

TEXT.English: 详细: 玛哈拉命令你去保护伊利安遗族人民。为了保证他们的生存，你必须用军队消灭与他们敌对的全部敌人。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]特殊规则: 伊利安遗族不能被击败
TEXT.German: Beschreibung: Mahala hat Euch befohlen, den Illianern zu helfen. Wenn sie überleben sollen, müsst Ihr die Armeen vernichten, die sich ihnen entgegenstellen.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Besondere Regeln: Falls die Illianer ausgelöscht werden, ist die Partie verloren.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Belohnung: Der erfolgreiche Abschluss dieses Szenarios gewährt Zugang zum Szenario "Blut der Engel".

TEXT.English: 为伊利安人民的胜利而战！
TEXT.German: Schütze die Illianer indem du alle anderen Nationen vernichtest

TEXT.English: 重生时代开始后新的国家在厄瑞波斯形成。多维洛部落的势力像融雪般退却。人们互相争论是联合大家微薄的财力重新开始还是就此放弃。一少部分坚信他们这些跟随被击败的神的走狗必将灭亡。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]但先知说还有希望。一个伊利安人是穆尔卡恩的转世，他可以成为新的冬日之神。有些人不相信，但是已经没有其他的路可走。你集合了所有部落成员做关于这些情况的演讲并宣称对伊利安的忠诚，然后去寻找这些遭受攻击的可怜人。一些"优秀"的国家联合起来要赶走他们，如果这个人是预言中的神，你必须在战争中拯救伊利安人。
TEXT.German: Das Zeitalter der Wiedergeburt hat begonnen und neue Reiche enstehen überall auf Erebus. Mit dem Rückzug des Eises geht auch die Macht der Doviello zu Ende. Unsere Leute kämpfen untereinander um unsere mageren Ressourcen oder verlassen unser Volk gleich ganz. Viele glauben, dass wir innerhalb weniger Generationen verschwunden sein werden, das verhungernde Schoßtier eines besiegten Gottes.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Aber unsere Propheten sagen, dass es noch Hoffnung gibt. Ein Mann, ein gebürtiger Illian, trägt den wiederauferstandenen Mulcarn in sich und kann zum Gott des Winters aufsteigen. Einige weigern sich zuzuhören, aber es gibt keine Alternative, wenn wir überleben wollen. Ihr versammelt Euren Stamm, um diese Nachricht zu überbringen und den Illian Eure Gefolgschaft zu schwören, aber als Ihr ankommt, werden sie bereits angegriffen. Die "guten" Reiche haben sich zusammengeschlossen, um die Illian auszurotten. Wenn der Mann aus der Prophezeiung überleben soll, müsst Ihr den Illian in dieser Schlacht beistehen und den Angriff zurückschlagen.

TEXT.English: 重重防守下的格利高里首都是堕落腐朽的。你的人发现格利高里地牢中囚禁着2个祭司。这两个祭司被送到你的首都，这是他们向你宣誓效忠的地方。
TEXT.German: Außer den Verteidigern befindet sich niemand in der Hauptstadt der Grigori. Allerdings finden Eure Männer doch noch 2 Priester, die im Verlies der Grigori gefangen gehalten wurden. Die Priester werden in Eure Hauptstadt geschickt, wo sie Euch Treue schwören.

TEXT.English: 传令使者已经准备去警告班诺尔联邦，他们已经彻底失败。但是特锡拉作为他们最后的都市却选择抵抗到底，残存的士兵退入了宫殿中。那个建筑在被你点燃后，里面传出的尖叫声令你非常满意。这次军事胜利鼓舞了部队，他们的经验值上升了。
TEXT.German: Während Eure Armee die bannorische Hauptstadt einnimmt, ist Capria längst geflohen. Ihr letztes Aufgebot verschanzt sich im Palast und gibt befriedigende Schreie von sich, als Ihr das Gebäude anzündet. Euer militärischer Sieg beflügelt Eure Truppen und steigert ihre Erfahrung.

TEXT.English: 在你的指引下军队在埃洛希姆的境内节节推进，胜利感召人们加入你的帝国，并增强了你城市的文化范围。
TEXT.German: Geschichten Eures Sieges über die Elohim steigern Euren Einfluss und erweitern die Grenzen Eurer Städte, als immer mehr Leute Eurem Reich beitreten wollen.

TEXT.English: The Illians' homeland has been reclaimed. The Illian elders are grateful for your help and they listen intently to your story of the prophecy. Together you set out to the site of Mulcarn's death, the ruins of Letum Frigus. You arrive just as Illian man walks out of the ruins. He is barely covered but unaffected by the freezing temperature.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"I am the one you seek, Auric Ulvin, the reborn form of the god of winter. Follow me and this world will belong to us again."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Around you men drop to their knees in worship, Doviello and Illian alike. Could this young man be the god you seek?
TEXT.German: Die Heimat der Illian wurde zurückgewonnen. Die Weisen der Illian sind für Eure Hilfe dankbar und hören Eurer Geschichte und der Prophezeiung aufmerksam zu. Gemeinsam mit ihnen begebt Ihr Euch zu der Stätte von Mulcarns Tod, den Ruinen von Letum Frigus. Als Ihr ankommt, verlässt ein Mann gerade die Ruinen. Er hat nur Fetzen am Leib, aber offenbar spürt er die eisigen Temperaturen nicht.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Ich bin jener, welchen ihr sucht, Auric Ulvin, der wiedergeborene Gott des Winters. Folgt mir und diese Welt wird wieder uns gehören."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Um Euch herum fallen Männer in Ehrfurcht auf ihre Knie, Doviello und Illian gleichermaßen. Könnte dieser Mann der Gott sein, den Ihr sucht?

TEXT.English: 黑暗之塔
TEXT.German: Schwarzer Turm

TEXT.English: 详细: 特布里恩想毁掉这个世界。他集结了他手下的将军，并从他控制的地狱地形上获得了扭曲的力量。为了阻止末日钟的上升，必须在这里击败特布里恩。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]特殊规则：这个剧情里有生命的单位不能回复生命值。死亡的生命单位将会转化为特布里恩所控制的恶魔单位。在未击破其他所有的塞安隐修会玩家时，特布里恩的领土是无法进入的。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]条件：完成「光辉卫士」的剧情。
TEXT.German: Beschreibung: Tebryn hat vor, die Welt zu zerstören. Er hat seine Gneräle um sich versammelt und die Macht des Totenreichs unter seine Kontrolle gebracht. Wenn Armageddon verhindert werden soll, muss Tebryn hier aufgehalten werden.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Besondere Regeln: Menschliche Einheiten können in diesem Szenario nicht geheilt werden. Menschliche Einheiten, die getötet werden, werden als Dämonen-Einheit unter Tebryns Kontrolle wiedergeboren. Tebryns Reich kann nicht betreten werden, bis nicht alle anderen sheaïmischen Oberhäupter besiegt sind.

TEXT.English: 击败爱华拉克斯、高希、马加别克
TEXT.German: Besiegt Averax, Gosea und Malchavic

TEXT.English: 击败特布里恩
TEXT.German: Besiegt Tebryn

TEXT.English: 一位英雄加入了你的麾下
TEXT.German: Ein Held ist eurer Armee beigetreten

TEXT.English: Rhoanna lay tangled in the sheets. She was as beautiful and fierce as any woman, and a lifetime spent in the saddle had turned last night's passion into an athletic event. Falamar had always felt himself a more than adequate, some had said legendary, lover but Rhoanna was insatiable. Falamar slipped quietly from the bed in the fear that if she awoke she would not let him escape. He felt sudden sympathy for the wild mustangs Rhoanna had ridden until they broke and surrendered to her will.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Up on deck the sea air revived him and he stretched and called for a report from Amergin, and a hot tea from a deck hand.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"No rum captain?" the deck hand asked.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"My body aches enough this morning Rory, best to at least keep my mind sharp." Falamar answered, then turning to Amergin he said, "How close are we to the Dead Lands?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"We will be upon them by midday. There are already reports that the Sheaim are readying for us, and our advance ship returned during the night crewed by skeletons. We had to sink it ourselves."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Falamar's eyes widened and he called down to Rory in the mess, "on second thought I'll take a bit of rum with that, on the side." Looking back at Amergin he asked, "Anything else?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"The Dead Lands appear much as our own except at its heart where it's as defiled as Hyborem's own lands. Tebryn has a spell around these lands that keeps anyone from entering without his approval. This spell is maintained by ritualists in the capital of his generals, Averax, Gosea and Malchavic. Until they are destroyed we won't be able to assault Tebryn directly."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Rory placed the hot tea and rum at Falamar's side and asked, "Anything else captain?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"No, thank you Rory." Falamar quickly drank the rum before asking Amergin to continue.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"There are reports that men who die within this region find their souls drawn to the black tower, where they are transformed into hellish versions of themselves, skeletons, wraiths, sect of flies, eidolons and such. I cannot imagine a worse fate for a man's soul, and for us it means that we will face any we lose in battle."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"I'm going to need more rum!" Falamar yelled to Rory, who quickly scrambled to refill Falamar's goblet.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Anything else Amergin?" Falamar asked.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"The living seem unable to heal here. Those injured in the battle against the skeleton ship still bleed as if their wounds were fresh. These lands are cursed, and it does not favor us."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Falamar downed the second rum, "And what of the rum?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"We are well stocked captain."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Lock away my enemy in an unassailable location, subject me to the threat of eternal damnation as some wretched bone pile, remove from me even the tiny gifts of health and healing, but leave the rum."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Aye captain." Amergin grinned, a rare sight on the first mate.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"You had best rouse our guest and tell her everything you have told me. We will need all the strength we have by midday."

这里举行的庆祝会的狂欢程度甚至会让普宾塔克嫉妒。当布里恩死的时候，黑塔在他四周倾塌。许多人好特布里恩是否在这次攻击下幸存，直到他们注意到土地和伤员开始恢复。来自不同国家的人开始畅饮、高歌，数个月以来的第一次放松。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]法拉玛抓起一瓶稀有的斯瓦塔尔法酒去找罗安娜。这场战争令双方无暇相处，法拉玛已经有好几个星期没见过罗安娜了。此刻将与她见面，心里的激动不亚于即将打败塞安隐修会时的心情。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]他在她的船长中间找到了她，旁边站着个不认识的希普斯佣兵国信使。他注意到虽然周围的人都在庆祝胜利，但是唯有他们在用一种很低沉的伤心语气说话。法拉玛停下了步伐。他没有看到眼泪，只看到了愤怒和决心。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“一切都还好嘛？”法拉玛问，同时把酒放下，拿着瓶酒在那里傻站着明显不适合现在的气氛。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]船长们安静下来向法拉玛敬礼，但是没有回答法拉玛提出的问题。罗安娜给了法拉玛一张疲惫的笑脸，她很高兴能见到他，在目前的情况下见到法拉玛令罗安娜多少有点欣慰。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“塔松克是奥洛尔部落的头领，而奥洛尔部落是最强盛的希普斯部落。他...曾经他对于我们而言是最接近国王的存在。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]她停了一下。法拉玛知道塔松克，罗安娜曾经多次提及这个人，用夹杂着失望和敬畏的语气。不过即使罗安娜没有提起过，在厄瑞波斯也没几个人没有听过希普斯佣兵王的名字。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“伊利安遗族在北方兴起壮大。”罗安娜继续说道“他们雇佣塔松克帮他们打仗。当他们不再需要塔松克的时候，他们杀了他，并且开始屠杀整个奥洛尔部落。没有几个人逃过那次大屠杀。奥瑟若-塔-米尔瑟尔不复存在了，我们的人民被屠杀殆尽，唯一存留下来的就是目前在这里战斗的人。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]法拉玛在罗安娜旁边坐下。船长们的表情很严酷，明显在讨论下一步的行动。尽管他们很尊敬法拉玛，但他们认为这是希普斯的事情，不愿意把法拉玛牵涉进来，除非罗安娜想这么做。法拉玛猜到了争论的要点，某些人想攻打伊利安以报仇，而其他的人想撤退到安全的地方休养生息。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“希普斯和拉努恩的命运交缠在一起，你随时可以得到我的支持。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“即使我们与伊利安作战？”罗安娜问道，“我听到报告说伊利安的领袖打算唤醒冬神把我们置于永恒的冬天。他们现在已经在准备魔法仪式。你能这么快的从塞安隐修会的火焰跳到伊利安的寒风中么？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]法拉玛陷入思索。他并没预料到又要打一场战争，而且他的手下早该休息了，他们已经可以因为今天在这里的胜利而载入史册。他怎能让他们放弃目前的胜利而马上投入下一场绝望的战争。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]罗安娜看到法拉玛贼笑的时候，就知道他会参加这场战争。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“这取决于，”法拉玛问到“我们是否会再坐同一艘旗舰”
仪式
TEXT.German: Der Kult

TEXT.English: 描述：奥里克在寻找原境山口————传说中神的杀戮机器休息的地方[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]特殊规则：这个战役主要是一个地牢，玩家必须征服整个地牢以赢得胜利[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]要求：已完成足跟之下战役
TEXT.German: Beschreibung: Auric begehrt den Pristinpass, den legendären Lagerplatz der Kriegsmaschinen der Götter.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Besondere Regeln: Diese Szenario beinhaltet einen Dungeon, der erobert werden muss, um das Szenario erfolgreich zu beenden.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Belohnung: Der erfolgreiche Abschluss dieses Szenarios gewährt Zugang zum Szenario "Mulcarns Wiedergeburt".

TEXT.English: 找到山脚下的通道
TEXT.German: Findet den Pass unter den Bergen

TEXT.English: 穿过地牢到达原境山口
TEXT.German: Durchquert den Dungeon, um zum Pristinpass zu kommen

TEXT.English: 击败塞安隐修会和库里奥塔特
TEXT.German: Besiegt die Sheaïm und die Kuriotaten

TEXT.English: 桌上摆着一大堆图纸。塔松克不得不在各种地形图、能量节点分布图、热力图中寻找神以前所在的位置，虽然他擅长阅读地貌、行军路线和防御工事，但是却无法看懂眼前的这堆图纸，在他看来图纸的描述很模糊而且图与图之间缺乏关联而无法对照。但冬之祭司却不同意这种看法。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]如今是奥里克的人指挥这军队。奥里克已回自己的帐篷，留下卢西恩、塔松克和祭司一起。塔松克不喜欢与走卒打交道，而且寻找一个根本不存在的山谷也让他提不起动力[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]塔松克离开了会议室。整个营地由三只队伍组成。多维洛部落的人性格过于浮躁而难以合群，于是只能自己聚一起。而希普斯和伊利安的人则一起巡逻、喝酒和聊天。塔松克走到营地中间奥里克的帐篷前，卢西恩休息去了而没有在这里站岗。站岗的是希普斯的士兵，他们没有拦塔松克的路。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]帐篷里一片漆黑并且异常的冷，塔松克不得不停下脚步。无法看清前方的任何东西，塔松克犹豫了一下是否从来时的路返回，坚定了下决心后，继续前进，虽然速度很慢。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“奥里克王？是我斯塔克，我为希普斯人民的福祉来询问你一些问题。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]奥里克睁开双眼，帐篷里立刻沐浴在蓝色和白色的光中。黑影与蓝色的火焰纠缠在一起，整个房间闪烁不定充满了摇曳的阴影。阴影里露出破败的城市，邪恶而强大的怪物，正激烈酣战的队伍。奥里克坐在中间，惨白的肌肤上挂满了在寒风中结冰的汗珠。他张开嘴说话，却没有发出声音[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]塔松克把手放在剑把上。对方已经不是人了，而是被某种远比塔松克强大的存在占据的怪物。一开始，塔松克只想保护自己免受奥里克伤害，转念一想，杀死奥里克或许能让奥里克从这折磨中解脱。但当奥里克扑过来的时候，塔松克却在惊恐中后退了几步。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“原境山口”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]声音从奥里克的嘴中传出来，但却仿佛有千百种不同声音一样在帐篷里回声震荡。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“只有一个入口，你必须从山底下走才能找到。小心，这块土地已经被争夺多时了。如果我们想得到它的话，我们必须扫清整个山谷。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]奥里克说话的时候他的皮肤变得更加惨白，但是当他看着塔松克的时候突然变成黑色。塔松克轻轻的点了点头。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“我会把您的命令告诉祭司的。对于您的军队或希普斯您还有什么命令嘛？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]奥里克剧烈的咳嗽，一股非人的声音从他身体里穿过，像要撕破他身体一般，随即吐出了一片湿淋淋的肉到地上。奥里克用自己的手套擦拭自己的嘴。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“别再烦我，警告你的手下好好的守卫我，很快你就会给冬神奉上无价的服务。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]在房间摇曳的阴影里，一条巨龙腾空怒吼。奥里克闭上双眼，房间马上又恢归平静。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]塔松克跌跌撞撞的走出帐篷。外面的阳光带来久违的舒畅。但是他守卫原来站的地方只剩下一个冻僵的躯壳。塔松克派了新的守卫站岗，警告他们不能让任何人进去，然后马上将奥里克的信息传达给祭司。

奥里克率领他的将军们下到龙的巢穴里。洞穴里的冰之能量使整个巢穴沐浴在苍蓝色的光中。巢穴的中间看起来曾经是个地下湖，但是现在已经结冰了。雪花覆盖在冰面上，一头巨龙的残骸被冻在冰里。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]奥里克比塔松克上次进入帐篷的时候看起来更有点像人类了，虽然奥里克是付出了很大的努力才使自己看起来如此的。他的手套因为风干的血迹而呈现出棕色，他的皮肤因为沾满水分而显得有点闪亮。自从上次帐篷里的意外后，塔松克学着卢西恩的样子，站在那里一动不动，丝毫不提洞穴里的龙已经死了的事实。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]奥里克走到冰面上。摸着龙骨架的鼻子，奥里克对着曾经是龙耳的地方悄声说话。塔松克偷偷看了卢西恩一眼，看他对他们那么大的努力换来的只是一头龙的残骸怎么反应的。不管卢西恩是失望还是惊讶，他隐藏得很好。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]突然另一股刺耳的非人的咳嗽穿过奥里克的身体。他努力使自己在巨龙的骨架面前站稳，当他恢复过来的时候他倾身靠近巨龙，然后对着龙嘴吹起来。奥里克的呼出来的气是白色的而且充满霜，并在吹过龙骨架的时候越变越大。这寒气像雪一样附在龙骨上，然后龙骨上慢慢长出肌肉。在大家睁大眼睛看着的时候，白龙德瑞法重生了。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]随着肌肉的逐渐长全，白龙开始移动自己的身躯。虽然还有大半身是骨架，德瑞法从湖中站起来，开始舒展龙翼，困住他的冰也被逐渐打碎。当他从湖中完全出来的时候，他已经长满了龙鳞、牙齿和肌肉了。德瑞法低头用纯蓝色的眼睛看着奥里克。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“是谁将我弄醒？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“我是你的神，我是重生后的穆尔卡恩。我现在离变成真正的冬神只差一步了。你会像服侍冬神一样的服侍我。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]德瑞法眯着眼睛仔细的观察奥里克。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“我沉睡了太久了，但我喜欢国王肉的味道，虽然你可能在某天登神，但你现在还是个国王。如果你想要我的服侍，你必须献祭一个国王给我。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]奥里克点点头，一点也不惊讶。他走到塔松克面前。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“现在是你为冬神服务的时候了。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]塔松克最后一眼所看到的是扑到他身上的德瑞法。
莫摩斯
TEXT.German: Der Momus

TEXT.English: 对老一套的围攻没有兴趣[NEWLINE]我有一个更好的主意[NEWLINE] 你们一起上吧[NEWLINE] 全部给我死[NEWLINE]我们将尽情享受这一天
I've fallen so far from my home and I'm cursed to be buried in these crazed lands. I would have done better to fall on the horseman's spear than in his cage.
TEXT.German: Ich bin gefallen, so weit weg von meiner Heimat. Und ich bin verflucht, dass ich in diesen verrückten Landen begraben werde. Mir wäre es besser ergangen, wenn ich in den Speer des Reiters gestürzt wäre, anstatt in seinen Käfig.

TEXT.English: 我听到……一个甜美的声音对我低声细语。带着你的锋刃，到这儿来和我一起品尝鲜血。
TEXT.German: Ich höre... eine süße Stimme, die mir zuflüstert. Sie heißt Euer Schwert willkommen. Kommt und trinkt mit mir auf sie.

TEXT.English: 这不是真正的战争、反复无常地发起、结束的战争，没有任何意义。
TEXT.German: Das ist kein richtiger Kampf. Ich kann Kriege nicht genießen, die aus einer Laune heraus erst erklärt und dann einfach beendet werden.

TEXT.English: 如果我死了、把我的身子捆扎起来、一起游荡吧？
TEXT.German: Wenn ich fort bin, werdet ihr dann Schnüre an meinem Körper anbringen und auch mit mir spielen?

TEXT.English: 「留在这赢得比赛固然很好、但是还有别的更要紧的是要去做。」
TEXT.German: Ich würde gerne bleiben, um diesen Wettkampf zu gewinnen, aber mich erwarten noch andere Verpflichtungen.

TEXT.English: 「这次的试练又失败了。但是至少、只有我丢了性命。」
TEXT.German: Dies ist eine weitere Prüfung, in der ich versagt habe. Allerdings ist dieses Mal zumindest nur mein Leben verloren.

TEXT.English: 「虽然在这获得褒奖能使我有不低于塔松克他本人的名声。但是会放慢我们前进的步伐。」
TEXT.German: Die Belohnung hätte mich ebenso bekannt gemacht wie Tasuke selbst, aber wir waren zu langsam.

TEXT.English: 「我厌恶失败。在我们感觉心情畅快之前究竟还要杀多少人、你知道吗？」
TEXT.German: Ich hasse es zu verlieren. Wisst ihr überhaupt, wieviele Leute ich töten muss, bevor ich wieder anfange, mich besser zu fühlen?

TEXT.English: 详细: 普宾塔克举办了一个由形形色色武将参加的比赛、胜者将从小丑王那获得丰厚的奖品。除此之外，能在比赛中存活下来的人很少。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]特殊规则: 所有的宣战公告将通过普宾塔克发布、不能随意变更。有可能命令所有人对一个可怜的人发动攻击、所以全体人员必须要有与众人战斗的打算。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]条件: 动物博览会的剧本完结。
TEXT.German: Beschreibung: Perpentach veranstaltet einen Wettbewerb zwischen verschiedenen Kriegsherren und der Sieger erhält vom Clownkönig eine große Belohnung. Die anderen überleben selten.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Besondere Regeln: Perpentach hat in dieser Partie Kontrolle über alle Kriegserklärungen und spricht sie je nach Lust und Laune aus. Er könnte allen befehlen, sich auf einen Gegner zu stürzen, oder verkünden, dass jeder gegen jeden kämpfen soll.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Belohnung: Der erfolgreiche Abschluss dieses Szenarios gewährt Zugang zum Szenario "Die Strahlende Wache".
